name: Cerro Guanaco
why: The hardest hike in the park and its best view: the Beagle Channel, Lapataia bay and Lago Acigami from 970 m.
book: Park entry ticket at the gate. Register at the Lago Acigami ranger post.
water: Only at the start: carry 2 litres.
dangers: A peat bog half way that swallows boots after rain.
The summit ridge is slate scree in strong wind; snow possible all summer.
turnaround: Start up from the bog by 12:00, or you will come down in the dark in March.

points.name: Lago Acigami (Lago Roca)
points.note: Start at the ranger post by the lake; the path enters the forest at once and climbs.

points.name: Cerro Guanaco peat bog
points.note: A flat, wet valley half way up: the last easy ground.

points.name: Cerro Guanaco
points.note: 970 m. Beagle Channel, Lapataia bay and the Chilean border mountains.
